# Movie Rater

Movie Rater is a Traditional Chinese website for Taiwan movie discovery. It compares IMDb, LINE, and PTT movie signals, shows current Taiwan theater schedules, and lists upcoming movie releases.

## Primary Pages

- Home / now playing: https://www.mvrater.com/
- Upcoming releases: https://www.mvrater.com/upcoming
- Theater list: https://www.mvrater.com/theaters
- Search: https://www.mvrater.com/search
- Sitemap: https://www.mvrater.com/sitemap.xml
- Robots: https://www.mvrater.com/robots.txt

## URL Patterns

- Movie detail pages: `https://www.mvrater.com/movie/{movieBaseId}`
- Theater schedule pages: `https://www.mvrater.com/theater/{encodedTheaterName}`

## Content Notes

- Movie pages include title, poster, release date, genres, runtime, directors, actors, summary, rating signals, Taiwan showtimes when available, and related PTT articles.
- Theater pages include theater name, region/city, address, phone, and current showtimes when available.
- Data is refreshed by scheduled crawlers and exposed through server-rendered HTML for crawlers and browsers.
